questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark ‘(?)’ in the following equation, if ‘÷’ and ‘×’ are interchanged and ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged?

47 − 5 ÷ 2 + 72 × 6 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 47 − 5 ÷ 2 + 72 × 6 = ?

Now, if ‘÷’ and ‘×’ and ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 47 + 5 × 2 − 72 ÷ 6 = ?

⇒ 47 + 5 × 2 − __**72 ÷ 6**__ = ? 

⇒ 47 + __**5 × 2**__ − 12 = ?

⇒ __**47 + 10**__ − 12 = ? 

⇒ __**57 − 12**__ = __**45**__.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Which is the number on the face opposite to the face containing 1?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fdfe6622bc78f8355cdb170e1ac06c79d047809e9d2f47eac0cd22b3379b38f.png]
questions.solution:
Given,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f55d76d4b7e450753cfbccf2c7249c6094f2853e8acd3800c47603d4c712c092.png] 

From the two positions of the dice, the common number is **6**.

By rotating clockwise from the common number 6 in both figures:

 
• Figure 1: 6 → 5 → 4
 
• Figure 2: 6 → 3 → 2

The pairs of opposite faces are:

 
• 5 is opposite 3
 
• 4 is opposite 2

The only number remaining is **1**, which must be opposite the common number **6**.

Therefore, the number on the face opposite to the face containing 1 is **6**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1 – L, M, N and O are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2 – P, Q, R and S are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus, each person faces another person from the other row. M sits third to the right of N. The one facing Q is an immediate neighbour of N. The one facing O is an immediate neighbour of Q. The one facing M is an immediate neighbour of R. S sits at some place to the left of P.

Who among the following faces R?
questions.solution:
Given, Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1 – L, M, N and O are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2 – P, Q, R and S are seated and all of them are facing north.

M sits third to the right of N.

The one facing Q is an immediate neighbour of N.

The one facing O is an immediate neighbour of Q.

The one facing M is an immediate neighbour of R.

S sits at some place to the left of P.

And L sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e94048370c0053a34421d44fc24d5c56d9761accee6c6573ff5a7faebf98536e.png] 

So, **O faces R.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All cubs are foals.

All cubs are puppies.

All kittens are puppies.

Conclusions:

(I): All kittens are foals.

(II): Some puppies are foals.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All cubs are foals.

All cubs are puppies.

All kittens are puppies.

The Venn diagrams for the given statements are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/660a0029b95c715d6c4ddd5d78aa6a8c2fe53d12a19b00edabd6106fc4f12cb3.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): All kittens are foals. - **False**. (There is no direct relationship or overlap specified between kittens and foals. The circle for 'Kittens' is inside 'Puppies', and the circle for 'Cubs' is inside both 'Puppies' and 'Foals'. This does not mean 'Kittens' must also be in 'Foals'.)

(II): Some puppies are foals. - **True**. (Since all 'Cubs' are both 'Puppies' and 'Foals', the circle for 'Cubs' is in the overlapping region of the 'Puppies' and 'Foals' circles. Therefore, there must be some 'Puppies' that are also 'Foals').

So, only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means ‘A is the mother of B’,

'A – B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,

'A × B' means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

'A ÷ B' means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is Q related to T if ‘P + Q – R × S ÷ T’?

Given Expression: P + Q – R × S ÷ T

We can break down the expression as follows:

 
• P + Q: P is the **mother** of Q.
 
• Q – R: Q is the **brother** of R. 
 
• R × S: R is the **wife** of S.
